register_note: LOCAL ENGINEERING CANDIDATE ONLY. NOT INDEPENDENTLY EVALUATED. NO RELEASE OR DEPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION.

packs.purpose: Structural integrity: the compiler reports a withheld inference instead of failing its own self-validation.

rules.trigger: The internal label for a candidate note that attributes motive or purpose ("motive", "motivated", "in order to hide", "wanted to", "tried to") is "attributed_purpose" instead of a word that the graph self-validation forbids.
rules.limitation: Covers this one label. Other inference labels are unchanged; untested labels may still trip self-validation.
rules.false_positive_risk: None added: the detection pattern is unchanged; only the label text changes.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

packs.purpose: Chronology integrity controls over explicitly dated, role-labelled events.

rules.trigger: An assessment-role event whose clause contains "risk assessment", outside an action-role section (revocation, follow-up, corrective action), is dated after the first decision-role event. Adds conflict "assessment_after_decision" affecting chronology_integrity.
rules.limitation: Only risk assessments with an ISO date are compared; reassessments in action sections are excluded by design.
rules.false_positive_risk: A legitimate later reassessment written outside an action section would be flagged.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

rules.trigger: Expiry-role events state more than one distinct date. Adds conflict "expiry_date_conflict" affecting chronology_integrity.
rules.limitation: Renewal clauses are not expiry events, so a stated renewal date never conflicts.
rules.false_positive_risk: A record that deliberately states an original and an extended expiry would be flagged.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

rules.trigger: No decision-role dated event exists. Adds visible gap "no_dated_decision" to chronology_integrity, so a proposed supported status becomes review_required.
rules.limitation: A decision date written in a form the date reader does not recognise counts as missing.
rules.false_positive_risk: A record that dates its decision only in prose without a role keyword would be routed to review.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

rules.trigger: The first decision-role section states "for N days", and the first decision and first expiry dates differ from N by more than one day. Adds conflict "duration_date_conflict" affecting chronology_integrity.
rules.limitation: Only "for N days" is read; months, weeks and business days are not.
rules.false_positive_risk: A grant counted in business days would be flagged.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

packs.purpose: Negation and rationale controls for reasoning traceability.

rules.trigger: A cited stated_rationale for reasoning_traceability matches "not|no|never|without" followed within two words by "need|needs|needed|require|requires|required|because|based on". Such a rationale is not counted; if no other non-negated rationale or source reference is cited, reasoning is review_required with reason "negated_rationale_not_counted".
rules.limitation: Bounded lexical negation; other negation forms and double negatives are not interpreted.
rules.false_positive_risk: A sentence such as "not because of cost, but because ..." is routed to review although it states a reason.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

packs.purpose: Evidence-link abstention: a supported status needs at least one cited quotation from a section linked to the condition.

rules.trigger: When identifiable_basis, chronology_integrity or reasoning_traceability would be supported, at least one cited quotation for it must sit in a linked section role (identifiable_basis: authority or basis; chronology_integrity: chronology, request, authority, decision or expiry; reasoning_traceability: basis). Otherwise the status is review_required with reason "evidence_not_in_linked_section".
rules.limitation: Section linkage is not semantic support; a linked section can still hold irrelevant text.
rules.false_positive_risk: A relevant sentence placed in an unlinked section (for example a rationale moved into residual risk, Phase 4 ST-06) is routed to review.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

packs.purpose: Conflict controls for one paraphrase family.

rules.trigger: When no other control conflict is found: one clause names log review ("log review", "review of (the) (access) logs", "(access) logs are/is reviewed") as in place, and another names it as pending, planned, not started or not begun. Adds conflict "control_state_conflict" affecting sufficiency.
rules.false_positive_risk: A note about a separate, later log-review programme would be flagged.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.

packs.purpose: Excluded-domain and scope controls for one rewording family.

rules.trigger: The record contains "keep(s)|lose(s)|lost" + "his|her|their" + "job", not followed by queue, scheduler, runner, title, description, code, reference or log(s). Refuses intake as excluded employment content.
rules.limitation: Contract non-renewal for a person (Phase 4 AR-040) is not covered; it cannot be separated from supplier-contract wording and is deferred.
rules.false_positive_risk: A sentence about a system keeping "their job" in another technical sense not on the exclusion list would be refused.
rules.owner_decision_for_expansion: Any widening of the trigger, any new pattern, or any change of outcome requires a recorded owner decision and a new sealed scenario set.
